limitations: Two readers, three successful requests, and three discrete due times.
Safe-integer input parsing and corrupt stored JSON are represented by a rejected operation. SQL runtime parsing needs the implementation test.
Two archive exporters and one close on one initialized data-directory owner.
Readiness, dump and archive release progress are explicit fairness assumptions. A consumer retaining its lease can block close.
Cross-process PID/boot ownership, maintenance, initialization failures and filesystem durability need separate models and platform tests.
Two transactions with two attempts each, one current receipt, one earlier receipt and two exact source rows.
The callback copies missing rows and verifies the exact projection before completion. Arbitrary caller-supplied callbacks and SQL collision parsing need implementation tests.
